changeHypothesis.summary: Container freight scarcity and port congestion were real and 中远海控 H1 profit had exploded, but by Aug31 the company had already rerated sharply and the contemporaneous forecast explicitly projected 2022 and 2023 profit declines of about 20% each. V1.2 therefore treats the opportunity as peak-profit path risk rather than a simple low-multiple bargain.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Congestion could persist into 2022, but new capacity/normalization and the published forecast imply earnings need not remain at the 2021 peak.
disconfirmingEvidence: COSCO 60d excess versus CSI300 was +54.61pp by the aligned Aug31 cutoff.
The frozen forecast expected 2022 and 2023 profit to decline ~20% each.
Other shipping peers had materially different business mixes and profit conversion.

causalChain.mechanism: Slow vessel/container turnaround reduces effective capacity during strong peak-season demand.
Higher per-container revenue and strong utilization raised container segment margins dramatically, already visible in H1.
Alpha requires the post-2021 earnings path to be better than the already-frozen decline path, not merely another strong quarter.
causalChain.failureMode: 2021 peak profits confirm consensus while 2022-23 normalize as expected
